why: Delay shifts by attempt, and a shift of 40 or more would overflow time.Duration. Delay's only caller is Do in internal/retry/retry.go, whose attempt runs below p.MaxAttempts, and NewPolicy in internal/retry/policy.go refuses MaxAttempts above 8 and Base above 5s; Policy's fields are unexported, so no other value exists. The largest product is 5s << 7 = 10m40s, before the max cap.
